# WorkTool Console

Console manages WorkTool robots, callbacks, AI reply rules, groups, manual commands, scheduled tasks and event tasks.

Canonical site: https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn
Console API: https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/api/v1
Language: zh-CN

## Documentation

- [概览](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/overview.html): 平台定位、能力与目标
- [快速开始](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/quickstart.html): 绑定机器人并验证消息与事件链路
- [核心概念](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/core-concepts.html): 机器人、规则、引擎、回调
- [机器人与回调](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/robot-callback.html): 机器人添加与回调绑定
- [规则配置](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/rules.html): 匹配模式、优先级与模板
- [AI回复引擎](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/ai-provider.html): 引擎配置、测试与常见问题
- [群列表与标签](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/groups-tags.html): 群备注、同步、读取与标签目标
- [指令下发与查询](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/command-tasks.html): 立即发送、群操作、执行结果与取消
- [定时任务](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/scheduled-tasks.html): 单次、每天、每周、Cron 与错过执行
- [事件任务](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/event-tasks.html): 好友申请、群事件、顺序动作与日期变量
- [消息转发](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/forwarding.html): 转发规则与日志排查
- [消息监控与排障](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/monitoring.html): 监控视图与常见异常
- [常见问题](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/faq.html): 高频问题与处理方式
- [管理员手册](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/admin.html): 用户管理与安全建议
- [部署运维](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/deploy.html): 部署、时区、升级建议
- [环境变量参考](https://console.worktool.ymdyes.cn/docs/env-reference.html): .env.example 逐项说明与生产建议
